#!/usr/bin/env bash
# report-leg-failure.sh — the enriched leg-failure notice (gh-1363).
#
# Engine-side factory glue (the flip target of the factory workflow's
# «Link the run back to the issue» step — the bare-link poster). Ships in
# the factory-setup asset next to the other engine scripts; the workflow
# step becomes a thin caller:
#
#   run: bash -e "${RUNNER_TEMP}/factory-setup/scripts/report-leg-failure.sh"
#
# Behavior contract (gh-1363):
#   success      → the historical bare-link line, byte-identical (AC6 — no
#                  new comments on success paths).
#   otherwise    → ONE enriched comment built by the shipped pure builder
#                  js/common/legFailureReport.js (same factory-setup asset):
#                  phase, failing step name (jobs API), ≤30-line excerpt of
#                  `gh run view --log-failed`, run id + link, the leg-start
#                  pre-flight line when available, and the repeat count
#                  against prior `failure-signature:` lines on the issue.
#   degradation  → every probe failure drops its section, never the notice:
#                  if the builder output cannot be produced at all, the
#                  historical bare-link line is posted as the fallback.
#
# Env block of the calling workflow step (all optional unless noted):
#   NUMBER            issue to comment on (required — absent → exit 0, the
#                     PR-anchored lane has no issue to notice on)
#   OUTCOME           success | failure | cancelled | <other>
#   CI_RUN_URL        run URL (empty → built from GITHUB_* env)
#   PHASE             setup | ai-work | reporting (default ai-work — the
#                     notice covers the whole job; the setup path reports
#                     its own phase through the ticket comment)
#   PREFLIGHT_LINE    the canonical `git pre-flight: …` line captured at leg
#                     start (optional — the report includes it when available)
#   WORKFLOW_FILE     the leg workflow filename for the signature (default
#                     ai-teammate.yml)
#   GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_SERVER_URL, GITHUB_RUN_ID   (runner-provided)
#   GH_TOKEN / SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN  (gh auth, runner-provided)
#
# Rendering rides node (present on GH runners) + the shipped builder —
# ONE canonical implementation of the signature math and the report shape;
# this script is transport only. Payload bytes travel via stdin (never argv
# — E2BIG past 128 KiB, the same rule the token-usage publisher learned).
set -u

REPO="${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-}"
NUMBER="${NUMBER:-}"
OUTCOME="${OUTCOME:-}"

if [ -z "$NUMBER" ] || [ -z "$REPO" ]; then
  echo "::warning::report-leg-failure: NUMBER/GITHUB_REPOSITORY unset — nothing to notice on"
  exit 0
fi

RUN_URL="${CI_RUN_URL:-}"
if [ -z "$RUN_URL" ] && [ -n "${GITHUB_SERVER_URL:-}" ] && [ -n "${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-}" ]; then
  RUN_URL="$GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$REPO/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
fi

KIT_ROOT="${FACTORY_SETUP_ROOT:-$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)}"
KIT_JS="$KIT_ROOT/js/common/legFailureReport.js"
KIT_MARKUP="$KIT_ROOT/js/common/commentMarkup.js"
KIT_SHAPES="$KIT_ROOT/js/common/ticketKeyShapes.js"

# The historical bare-link line via the shipped builder, with a plain-shell
# fallback when node/the kit is unavailable — the notice itself must never
# depend on the enrichment stack.
leg_failure_outcome_line() {
  node -e 'const kit = require(process.argv[1]); process.stdout.write(kit.outcomeLine(process.argv[2], process.argv[3]))' \
    "$KIT_JS" "$1" "$2" 2>/dev/null \
    || printf '🤖 AI Teammate run %s: %s' "$1" "$2"
}
# AC6 — the success path stays the historical bare-link line.
if [ "$OUTCOME" = "success" ] || [ -z "$OUTCOME" ]; then
  gh issue comment "$NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" \
    --body "$(leg_failure_outcome_line "${OUTCOME:-success}" "$RUN_URL")"
  exit $?
fi

# The failed step name: first failed step of the first failed job.
STEP_NAME="$(gh run view "${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-}" --repo "$REPO" --json jobs \
  --jq 'first(.jobs[] | select(.conclusion == "failure") | .steps[] | select(.conclusion == "failure") | .name) // empty' \
  2>/dev/null || true)"
# older gh --jq prints JSON-encoded strings — strip a wrapping pair of quotes
STEP_NAME="${STEP_NAME%\"}"
STEP_NAME="${STEP_NAME#\"}"

# The excerpt: tail of the failed-step log, hard cap 30 (AC5).
EXCERPT="$(gh run view "${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-}" --repo "$REPO" --log-failed 2>/dev/null | tail -n 30 || true)"

# Prior signature history: this issue's own comments (existing surface —
# no new persistence), most recent last. A failed/empty read degrades to []
# — every probe failure must drop its section, never kill the notice.
PRIOR_BODIES="$(gh issue view "$NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" --json comments \
  --jq '[.comments[].body]' 2>/dev/null || true)"
PRIOR_BODIES="${PRIOR_BODIES:-[]}"
case "$PRIOR_BODIES" in
  \[*) : ;; # a JSON array — usable
  *) PRIOR_BODIES="[]" ;;
esac

# Build the enriched comment with the shipped builder. Payload via stdin.
NODE_PROG="$(cat <<'PROG_EOF'
const fs = require('fs');
// node -e argv: [node, kitJs, kitMarkup, kitShapes] — user args start at 1.
const kit = require(process.argv[1]);
const markup = require(process.argv[2]);
process.argv[3] && require(process.argv[3]);
const env = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0, 'utf8'));
const signature = kit.failureSignature({
  workflow: env.workflow, step: env.step, message: env.message
});
const repeat = kit.consecutiveRepeatCount(
  signature, kit.parseSignatureLines(env.priorBodies));
const body = kit.buildFailureComment({
  phase: env.phase,
  step: env.step,
  runId: env.runId,
  runUrl: env.runUrl,
  preflightLine: env.preflightLine,
  excerpt: env.excerpt,
  repeatCount: repeat,
  signature: signature
}, markup.forFlavor('markdown'));
process.stdout.write(body);
PROG_EOF
)"

PAYLOAD="$(jq -n \
  --arg workflow "${WORKFLOW_FILE:-ai-teammate.yml}" \
  --arg step "${STEP_NAME:-}" \

$EXCERPT" \

# Quality gate — per-function CRAP ratchet via crap4js (IstiN fork).
#
# Policy: CRAP may only DECREASE. The baseline (per-function CRAP of everything above
# CRAP_THRESHOLD) is NOT in the repository — with many agents opening PRs a committed file
# conflicts constantly. It lives in a rolling GitHub release asset:
#
#   release tag  crap-baseline   (prerelease, never "latest" — agent pack consumers resolve
#                                 releases/latest, so this one must not be it)
#   asset        crap-baseline.json
#
# pull_request / workflow_dispatch (the factory SM dispatches this on PR heads): measure the
#   head and COMPARE with the released baseline. Fails when a function's CRAP grew or a new
#   function exceeds CRAP_THRESHOLD; labels crap:regression / crap:improved.
# main (push, merge-bot completion via workflow_run — the bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, which
#   never fires 'push' —, or manual dispatch on main): after a green measurement, ratchet the
#   released baseline DOWN (crap4js --update-baseline: min(old, now), never up, refuses on
#   regression) and upload it. The release notes carry 'main@<sha>' so repeated triggers for
#   the same HEAD are skipped. Concurrent merges are serialized by the concurrency group.
# No baseline asset yet (first run / fork): bootstrap from the measured main, no comparison.
#
# Coverage comes from the unit suite run in the same job (instrumented tree), so the
# ratchet is evaluated with the unit-test results of the head.
#
# Duplication gate (gh-1251): a second, independent gate fails PRs and main on
# NEW or GROWING JS duplication. The measurement is
# `crap4js duplicates --threshold 1 --exclude "js/unit-tests/**" js ci`; a
# pinned set of production files already exceeds 1% today (pre-existing debt
# owned by the gh-1244…gh-1250 dedup tickets — see duplication-baseline.json
# for the current pinned set), so the gate is a RATCHET against that
# baseline, not an absolute bar — it fails only when a file over threshold is
# not pinned or a pinned file gained ABSOLUTE duplicated lines
# (ci/duplicationRatchet.js; percentage shifts from file shrinkage are
# informational, not failures). Its clones-mode report also feeds the README
# `duplication` endpoint badge published from the same run.
#
# Tool pin: IstiN/crap4js by commit SHA (fork of vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit/crap4js v0.15.0 +
# --baseline / --update-baseline, pipe-safe exit). Installed from GitHub — the npm 'crap4js'
# package is an unrelated third-party project.
name: Quality

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_run:
    # The merge bot merges with GITHUB_TOKEN, and GitHub suppresses workflow triggers on
    # GITHUB_TOKEN events — the push trigger above never fires for machine merges (same
    # reason agent-pack-release.yml listens to this workflow, gh-867). The bot's own run
    # completion is a normal event. Runs on every bot completion are cheap no-ops: the
    # 'gate' job skips when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
    workflows: ['Machine Merge Bot']
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:  # the Machine SM / sm-kicker dispatch validation runs; on main it re-seeds the baseline

permissions:
  contents: write        # push to main: update the crap-baseline release asset
  pull-requests: write   # crap:regression / crap:improved labels

# Serializes baseline updates of consecutive merges (never cancels a running update).
concurrency:
  group: quality-${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_run' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main') && 'baseline-update' || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # Threshold for functions NOT in crap-baseline.json (new or renamed code).
  CRAP_THRESHOLD: '8'
  CRAP4JS_REPO: 'IstiN/crap4js'
  CRAP4JS_REF: '83ee6201e554a91d51c298f045c5c4cb47317b6d'
  BASELINE_TAG: 'crap-baseline'
  BASELINE_ASSET: 'crap-baseline.json'

jobs:
  gate:
    # PR / dispatch on a PR head: always measure. Main-side events (push, merge-bot completion,
    # manual dispatch on main): measure only when the released baseline does not yet cover HEAD.
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.g.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - id: g
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          BOT_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: |
          main_side=false
          [ "$EVENT" = "push" ] || [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && main_side=true
          [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_dispatch" ] && [ "$REF" = "refs/heads/main" ] && main_side=true
          if [ "$main_side" != "true" ]; then
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; exit 0      # pull_request / dispatch on a PR head: always measure
          fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = "workflow_run" ] && [ "$BOT_CONCLUSION" != "success" ]; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "merge bot run was not successful — skip"; exit 0
          fi
          body="$(gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json body --jq .body 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q "main@${GITHUB_SHA}"; then
            echo "run=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; echo "baseline already covers ${GITHUB_SHA} — skip"
          else
            echo "run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  crap:
    needs: gate
    if: needs.gate.outputs.run == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install pinned tools (separate prefix — never node_modules here)
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools" --no-fund --no-audit \
            "github:${CRAP4JS_REPO}#${CRAP4JS_REF}" nyc@17

      - name: Instrument the tree (harness eval-loads bypass nyc's hook)
        run: |

          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/nyc" instrument --cwd . . \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          # nyc instrument copies only .js — add the json/md/sh payloads the
          # suite reads (configs, instructions, prompts, fixtures).
          rsync -a --exclude '*.js' --exclude '.git' ./ "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/"
          # (the factory board — and its pristine-app source guard — moved to
          # the dmtools-factory repo; nothing browser-side is text-read here anymore)
          # Tests call `git ls-files` (agentDocsCoverage): give the copied tree a throwaway
          # index of the same tracked files, without the real history.
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst" && git init -q && git add -A -f . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

      - name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Duplication gate (production JS duplicated lines <= 1%, ratcheted)
        # Ratchet, not an absolute bar: a pinned set of production JS files
        # already exceeds 1% duplicated lines — pre-existing debt owned by the
        # gh-1244…gh-1250 dedup tickets (see duplication-baseline.json for the
        # current pinned set) — so the measurement's exit 2 is expected for
        # now. The baseline pins each over-threshold file with its measured
        # percentage and absolute duplicated-line count; the gate FAILS only
        # on a NEW over-threshold file or a pinned file that gained ABSOLUTE
        # duplicated lines (ci/duplicationRatchet.js) — a percentage shift
        # caused by file shrinkage passes and is logged as informational —
        # keeping the absolute 1% bar as the end state once the debt lands.
        # A crashed measurement (tool exit other than 0/2) never passes.
        # js/unit-tests/** stays excluded; the badge step below reparses the
        # same measurement for the README endpoint.
        run: |
          set +e
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" duplicates --threshold 1 --exclude "js/unit-tests/**" js ci > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dup-gate.txt" 2>&1
          code=$?
          set -e
          node ci/duplicationRatchet.js "$RUNNER_TEMP/dup-gate.txt" duplication-baseline.json "$code"

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e

### 1. `PRRT_kwDORYAuYs6z9u-Z` — **unknown** (`js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:677`)

🚨 severity: BLOCKING —
🚨 **BLOCKING: CI red — crap ratchet fails on 3 new functions (threshold 8)**

The `crap` check fails on head `bfa60a51` (`ci_failures.md`, run [41984873724](https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents/actions/runs/41984873724/job/127103190928)):

```
NEW > 8  js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js::readEnvVar: 9
NEW > 8  js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js::deriveSetupRepeatCount: 10
NEW > 8  js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js::postSetupErrorComment: 13
0 regression(s), 3 new over threshold, 0 improvement(s), 0 removed
```

All three functions are introduced/mass-grown by this PR. The ratchet requires new code ≤ 8 — updating the baseline is not an option ("CRAP may only decrease").

Concrete split guidance (the repo's gh-1042 extraction pattern):

- `postSetupErrorComment` (CC 13) — extract the enrichment block (lines `if (!ctx.signature)` … `var enriched = …`) into `deriveEnrichmentContext(tracker, ticketKey, stage, errorMessage, context)`; the remainder is a single try/post/warn (CC ≈ 3).
- `deriveSetupRepeatCount` (CC 10) — extract the body-collection loop (`bodies.push(...)`) into a `commentBodies(comments)` helper; keep only signature derivation + try/catch here.
- `readEnvVar` (CC 9) — split into `readJavaEnv(name)` and `readProcessEnv(name)`, each one try/catch; `readEnvVar` becomes `readJavaEnv(name) || readProcessEnv(name)`.

Existing tests pin the behavior (150/150 pass locally), so a pure extraction is safe. Merge is blocked until the gate is green.

### 2. `PRRT_kwDORYAuYs6z9vAZ` — **unknown** (`js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:891`)

⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: pre-flight line captures the wrong workspace when `config.workingDir` is set**

`collectPreflightStateStep()` (this call site, step 1.4) runs **before** `checkoutBranchOrReport()` (step 2) — but `_workingDir` is assigned only inside `checkoutBranch()` (`js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js:330`), which is reached in step 2. At capture time `_workingDir` is still `null`, so `runCommandStr` → `runCmd` executes `git rev-parse` / `git status --porcelain` in the **process cwd (the agents repo)**, not in the configured target repository.

Consequence: for every dynamic-repo/`workingDir` setup (the mode `test_preCliDevelopmentSetupDynamicRepo.js` exists for), the `git pre-flight: branch=… head=… dirty=… staged=… paths=[…]` line in the failure report describes the agents checkout — where the leg never ran — instead of the target workspace the report is about. A post-hoc reader gets a confidently wrong `branch=`/`head=` (misleading diagnostics are worse than an omitted line, which the module already supports via `preflightLine(null)`).

Note the failure path itself is affected too: `checkoutBranch` sets `_workingDir` before failing, so the setup-error comment posts the stale wrong-workspace pre-flight line captured at step 1.4.

Suggested fix: resolve `config.workingDir` (from the already-loaded `config` at this point in `action()`) into `_workingDir` — or pass it explicitly to `collectPreflightStateStep(config.workingDir)` and thread it through `runCmd` — before the capture, and add a `workingDir` test asserting the pre-flight commands carry `workingDirectory` (the existing test at `test_preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` only covers the no-workingDir case).

### 3. `PRRT_kwDORYAuYs6z9vCG` — **unknown** (`scripts/report-leg-failure.sh:138`)

⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: `--argjson priorBodies` ships the whole comment history through argv — E2BIG past 128 KiB, contradicting this script's own rule**

The header of this script states: *"Payload bytes travel via stdin (never argv — E2BIG past 128 KiB, the same rule the token-usage publisher learned)"*. This line then puts the **largest payload component** — `PRIOR_BODIES`, i.e. every comment body on the issue (`gh issue view --json comments`) — on the jq command line as a single `--argjson` argv entry.

Demonstrated on Linux (`MAX_ARG_STRLEN` = 128 KiB): a ~140 KB array makes jq fail with `Argument list too long`. The failure is swallowed by `|| echo '{}'`, so the notice silently degrades to the bare-link fallback — **exactly on the issues where the feature matters most**: repeat-count context only renders when prior failure comments exist, and each failure cycle grows the history (this repo's issues routinely carry multi-KB bot notices, so 128 KiB is reachable within tens of comments).

Fix options (all keep `gh` output on non-argv channels):

```bash
# process substitution + --slurpfile: data never touches argv
jq -n --arg workflow "${WORKFLOW_FILE:-ai-teammate.yml}" ... \
  --slurpfile priorBodies <(printf '%s' "$PRIOR_BODIES") \
  '{...} * {priorBodies: $priorBodies[0]}'
```

or fold `PRIOR_BODIES` into the stdin JSON the node program already reads (`env.priorBodies`), dropping `--argjson` entirely. A regression test can pin it by piping a >128 KiB fixture through the payload build.

### 4. `PRRT_kwDORYAuYs6z9vDn` — **unknown** (`scripts/report-leg-failure.sh:11`)

💡 severity: SUGGESTION —
💡 **SUGGESTION: the advertised `--self-test` does not exist — the PR's stated verification command is a no-op**

The PR description's "How to verify" says `bash scripts/report-leg-failure.sh --self-test`. The script never parses `--self-test` (or any argument — it reads env vars only). Running it today just prints `::warning::report-leg-failure: NUMBER/GITHUB_REPOSITORY unset — nothing to notice on` and exits 0: the verification "passes" while testing nothing, which is worse than failing loudly.

arguments.newText:
// gh test double: records posted bodies to $GH_STUB_RECORD (separated by
    // --BOUNDARY--), serves canned payloads from the files $GH_STUB_JOBS /
    // $GH_STUB_LOG / $GH_STUB_COMENTS point at (paths, never bytes — a big
    // fixture must not travel env/argv either). jq filters are applied with
    // the real jq, like gh does.
    e2efs.writeFileSync(e2epath.join(STUBS, 'gh'), [
        '#!/usr/bin/env bash',
        'REC="${GH_STUB_RECORD:?GH_STUB_RECORD unset}"',
        'printf \'%s\\n\' "== gh $*" >> "$REC.calls"',
        'case "$1 $2" in',
        '  "issue comment")',
        '    if [ "$3" = "--body-file" ]; then cat >> "$REC"; else',
        '      prev=""',
        '      for a in "$@"; do',
        '        if [ "$prev" = "--body" ]; then printf \'%s\' "$a" >> "$REC"; fi',
        '        prev="$a"',
        '      done',
        '    fi',
        '    printf \'\\n--BOUNDARY--\\n\' >> "$REC"',
        '    exit 0 ;;',
        '  "run view")',
        '    case "$*" in',
        '      *--log-failed*) [ -n "${GH_STUB_LOG:-}" ] && cat "$GH_STUB_LOG" ;;',
        '      *)',
        '        prev=""',
        '        for a in "$@"; do',
        '          if [ "$prev" = "--jq" ]; then [ -n "${GH_STUB_JOBS:-}" ] && jq -r "$a" < "$GH_STUB_JOBS" 2>/dev/null; fi',
        '          prev="$a"',
        '        done ;;',
        '    esac',
        '    exit 0 ;;',
        '  "issue view")',
        '    prev=""',
        '    for a in "$@"; do',
        '      if [ "$prev" = "--jq" ]; then [ -n "${GH_STUB_COMENTS:-}" ] && jq -c "$a" < "$GH_STUB_COMENTS" 2>/dev/null; fi',
        '      prev="$a"',
        '    done',
        '    exit 0 ;;',
        'esac',
        'exit 0',
        ''
    ].join('\n'), { mode: 0o755 });

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# report-leg-failure.sh — the enriched leg-failure notice (gh-1363).
#
# Engine-side factory glue (the flip target of the factory workflow's
# «Link the run back to the issue» step — the bare-link poster). Ships in
# the factory-setup asset next to the other engine scripts; the workflow
# step becomes a thin caller:
#
#   run: bash -e "${RUNNER_TEMP}/factory-setup/scripts/report-leg-failure.sh"
#
# Behavior contract (gh-1363):
#   success      → the historical bare-link line, byte-identical (AC6 — no
#                  new comments on success paths).
#   unset        → a ::warning:: and no comment at all — a missing OUTCOME
#                  is a misconfiguration, never a fabricated "run success"
#                  (gh-1363 review).
#   otherwise    → ONE enriched comment built by the shipped pure builder
#                  js/common/legFailureReport.js (same factory-setup asset):
#                  phase, failing step name (jobs API), ≤30-line excerpt of
#                  `gh run view --log-failed`, run id + link, the leg-start
#                  pre-flight line when available, and the repeat count
#                  against prior `failure-signature:` lines on the issue.
#   degradation  → every probe failure drops its section, never the notice:
#                  if the builder output cannot be produced at all, the
#                  historical bare-link line is posted as the fallback.
#
# Env block of the calling workflow step (all optional unless noted):
#   NUMBER            issue to comment on (required — absent → exit 0, the
#                     PR-anchored lane has no issue to notice on)
#   OUTCOME           success | failure | cancelled | <other>
#   CI_RUN_URL        run URL (empty → built from GITHUB_* env)
#   PHASE             setup | ai-work | reporting (default ai-work — the
#                     notice covers the whole job; the setup path reports
#                     its own phase through the ticket comment)
#   PREFLIGHT_LINE    the canonical `git pre-flight: …` line captured at leg
#                     start (optional — the report includes it when available)
#   WORKFLOW_FILE     the leg workflow filename for the signature (default
#                     ai-teammate.yml)
#   GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_SERVER_URL, GITHUB_RUN_ID   (runner-provided)
#   GH_TOKEN / SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN  (gh auth, runner-provided)
#
# Rendering rides node (present on GH runners) + the shipped builder —
# ONE canonical implementation of the signature math and the report shape;
# this script is transport only. Payload bytes travel via stdin (never argv
# — E2BIG past 128 KiB, the same rule the token-usage publisher learned):
# the comment history enters the payload through `jq --slurpfile` fed by a
# process substitution, so the largest component never touches argv either.
#
# --self-test: `bash scripts/report-leg-failure.sh --self-test` exercises
# the contract end-to-end with a stub `gh` on PATH (node + jq run for real):
# the success byte-shape, the unset-outcome guard, the enriched failure
# report (incl. repeat count), the >128 KiB comment history (E2BIG rule)

# depend on the enrichment stack. The fallback default keeps both layers

      --body "$(leg_failure_outcome_line success "$RUN_URL")"

    exit 0
    ;;

  --jq 'first(.jobs[] | select(.conclusion == "failure") | .steps[] | select(.conclusion == "failure") | .name) // empty' \
  2>/dev/null || true)"

STEP_NAME="${STEP_NAME#\"}"

# — every probe failure must drop its section, never kill the notice.

  --jq '[.comments[].body]' 2>/dev/null || true)"
PRIOR_BODIES="${PRIOR_BODIES:-[]}"

// node -e argv: [node, kitJs, kitMarkup, kitShapes] — user args start at 1.

const markup = require(process.argv[2]);
process.argv[3] && require(process.argv[3]);

const signature = kit.failureSignature({
  workflow: env.workflow, step: env.step, message: env.message
});
const repeat = kit.consecutiveRepeatCount(
  signature, kit.parseSignatureLines(env.priorBodies));
const body = kit.buildFailureComment({
  phase: env.phase,
  step: env.step,
  runId: env.runId,
  runUrl: env.runUrl,
  preflightLine: env.preflightLine,
  excerpt: env.excerpt,
  repeatCount: repeat,
  signature: signature

# enters through --slurpfile + process substitution: argv carries only an

  --arg workflow "${WORKFLOW_FILE:-ai-teammate.yml}" \
  --arg step "${STEP_NAME:-}" \
  --arg message "${STEP_NAME:-}
$EXCERPT}" \
  --arg phase "${PHASE:-ai-work}" \
  --arg runId "${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-}" \
  --arg runUrl "$RUN_URL" \
  --arg preflightLine "${PREFLIGHT_LINE:-}" \
  --arg excerpt "$EXCERPT" \
  --slurpfile priorBodies <(printf '%s' "$PRIOR_BODIES") \
  '{workflow: $workflow, step: $step, message: $message, phase: $phase,
    runId: $runId, runUrl: $runUrl, preflightLine: $preflightLine,
    excerpt: $excerpt} * {priorBodies: $priorBodies[0]}' || echo '{}')"

BODY="$(printf '%s' "${PAYLOAD:-{\}}" | node -e "$NODE_PROG" "$KIT_JS" "$KIT_MARKUP" "$KIT_SHAPES" 2>/dev/null || true)"

else
  echo "::warning::report-leg-failure: enriched notice unavailable (node/builder failure) — bare-link fallback"
fi

gh issue comment "$NUMBER" --repo "$REPO" \
  --body "$(leg_failure_outcome_line "$OUTCOME" "$RUN_URL")"

# Thread `PRRT_kwDORYAuYs6z9u-Z` — 🚨 BLOCKING: crap ratchet fails on 3 new functions

**Fixed** on `ai/gh-1363` (rework content `6678c93e1..3c27347fc`, doc commit `b828b3c03`) — split exactly per the gh-1042 extraction pattern, no baseline touch:

| Function | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `readEnvVar` | 9 | 2 (split into `readJavaEnv` CC 4 + `readProcessEnv` CC 5) |
| `deriveSetupRepeatCount` | 10 | 5 (body-collection loop extracted into `commentBodies` CC 6) |
| `postSetupErrorComment` | 13 | 4 (enrichment block extracted into `deriveEnrichmentContext` CC 7 + `isEnrichedContext` CC 4) |

All new helpers are exported and pinned by direct branch-coverage tests (`js/unit-tests/test_preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` — "extracted enrichment helpers" suite), so each measures **100.0% cov → CRAP = CC ≤ 7** in the gate measurement.

Gate verification (replicated the CI `quality.yml` measurement locally: `nyc instrument` + full `run_all.json` coverage + `crap4js . --threshold 8 --baseline <released crap-baseline.json>`):

```
CRAP Ratchet
============
0 regression(s), 0 new over threshold, 0 improvement(s), 0 removed   ← exit 0
```

(was: `0 regression(s), 3 new over threshold` — readEnvVar 9, deriveSetupRepeatCount 10, postSetupErrorComment 13). The RED state was reproduced with the identical harness before the split; the 150 pre-existing behavior tests plus the new helper tests stayed green throughout (`run_preCliDevelopmentSetup.json` 82/82 under the dmtools runner).

# Thread `PRRT_kwDORYAuYs6z9vCG` — ⚠️ IMPORTANT: `--argjson priorBodies` ships the comment history through argv (E2BIG)

**Fixed** on `ai/gh-1363` (doc commit `b828b3c03`) with the slurpfile variant — data never touches argv:

```bash
--slurpfile priorBodies <(printf '%s' "$PRIOR_BODIES") \
'{...} * {priorBodies: $priorBodies[0]}'
```

The process substitution hands jq an fd path; the whole comment history (the largest payload component) travels kernel-side, so `MAX_ARG_STRLEN` can no longer degrade the notice to the bare link on exactly the recurring-failure issues.

**Regression test** (RED before the fix): a 150 000-char comment history (`> 128 KiB`) served by a stub `gh`, asserting the enriched body still carries the failing step, the signature line and `identical failure #2 in a row`. Under the old code the same fixture reproduced your demonstration — `jq: Argument list too long` swallowed by `|| echo '{}'`, leaving a gutted `### 🤖 AI Teammate run failed / Phase:`-only body. Both the unit e2e (`js/unit-tests/test_legFailureReport.js` — node-harness scenario suite) and the script's own `--self-test` scenario 4 pin it.

**Bonus bug found by the test**: the payload `--arg message` block carried a stray literal `}` after `$EXCERPT` (present in the original diff too), polluting the failure signature with a trailing `}`. Dropped — the signature is now exactly `workflow | step | normalized message`.

# PR Rework — 9 review threads fixed, CI crap gate green

## Issues/Notes

- **CI failure (the one failed check, `crap`)** — the three owned violations from the review thread are **fixed**:
  - `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js::readEnvVar` CRAP 9 → **fixed** (split into `readJavaEnv` + `readProcessEnv`; `readEnvVar` is now `readJavaEnv(name) || readProcessEnv(name)`, CRAP 2)
  - `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js::deriveSetupRepeatCount` CRAP 10 → **fixed** (comment-body loop extracted into `commentBodies`; CRAP 5)
  - `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js::postSetupErrorComment` CRAP 13 → **fixed** (enrichment block extracted into `deriveEnrichmentContext` + `isEnrichedContext`; CRAP 4)
  - Baseline not touched ("CRAP may only decrease"). Local replication of the CI measurement (`nyc instrument` + full `run_all.json` coverage + `crap4js . --threshold 8 --baseline` against the released `crap-baseline.json` release asset) reports **`0 regression(s), 0 new over threshold, 0 improvement(s), 0 removed`, exit 0** — was `3 new over threshold`.
  - `ci_violations.json` lists 8 further `unknown`-ownership entries — parser artifacts of the raw log (no attributable `path:line`), none in files this PR changes; nothing owned beyond the three above.
- **sessionDelta UT-3 AC3** (the full-suite "1 failed" + review challenge): verified **pre-existing and environment-specific, not a PR regression**. It fails identically on the clean base `f3183be` under the node harness (`expected "/tmp/copilot-home" but got ".dmtools/fa-sessions/…"` — a prior test's session context leaks into the deterministic-fallback assertion), and **passes 24/24 under the dmtools GraalJS runner** on the same clean base — which is why the review's local `run_all.json` run saw 0 failures. Both observations reconcile: the failure only reproduces in the node-harness environment, on this PR head **and** on clean base alike. Left for its owner (test-side, file untouched by this rework).
- **Scope note** (general-comment point 3): the engine-side factory workflow flip of `report-leg-failure.sh` remains outside this repo — agreed boundary; it needs its tracking issue in the engine repo so the workflow path does not stay bare.
- **Digest line not picked up** (stays for triage): the `legFailureReport` dead-stub entries in `js/unit-tests/test_workingDir.js` `loadModule` maps — different file from the mandatory set, harmless noise, machine triage owns the disposition.

## Approach

TDD per finding — every fix was RED first, then GREEN, with the full suite re-run after each change:

1. **🚨 crap ratchet (thread 1)** — reproduced the CI RED locally with the exact `quality.yml` harness (`readEnvVar` 9 / `deriveSetupRepeatCount` 10 / `postSetupErrorComment` 13), then split the three functions per the gh-1042 extraction pattern (pure extractions, existing 150 tests stayed green), then added direct branch-coverage tests for the five new helpers so each measures CRAP = CC ≤ 7 @ 100% cov, then re-measured GREEN against the released baseline.
2. **⚠️ wrong-workspace pre-flight (thread 2)** — RED test asserting the pre-flight git probes carry `workingDirectory` when `config.workingDir` is set; GREEN = resolve `_workingDir = config.workingDir` in `action()` immediately before `collectPreflightStateStep()` (mirrors the `checkoutBranch()` assignment it used to race).
3. **⚠️ argv E2BIG (thread 3)** — RED e2e with a 150 KiB comment-history fixture (stub `gh`, payloads in files so the fixture itself never travels env/argv); GREEN = `jq --slurpfile priorBodies <(printf '%s' "$PRIOR_BODIES")`, payload bytes only ever on stdin/fd. The RED run also surfaced a real pre-existing bug: a stray literal `}` after `$EXCERPT` leaked into the payload message and polluted the failure signature — dropped.
4. **💡 `--self-test` (thread 4)** — implemented as five scripted scenarios (success byte-shape / unset-outcome / enriched failure with repeat / E2BIG history / builder-unavailable fallback) over a stub `gh`; ambient CI env scrubbed per scenario so it is runner-safe.
5. **💡 duplicate excerpt (thread 5)** — excerpt renders only when caller-provided and distinct from the error text.
6. **💡 empty OUTCOME (thread 6)** — `case "$OUTCOME"`: real `success` keeps the historical line; unset warns and posts nothing.
7. **💡 grep-only suite (thread 7)** — behavioral e2e (self-test suite + node-harness scenario suite) replaces the substring greps; pack-registration pins kept.
8. **🪶 printf placeholder (thread 8)** + **🪶 `Phase: undefined` (thread 9)** — opportunistic one-liners with regression tests, both in files the mandatory set already touches.

## Files Modified

- `js/preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` — helper extraction (`readJavaEnv`/`readProcessEnv`/`commentBodies`/`deriveEnrichmentContext`/`isEnrichedContext`, all exported), workingDir resolution before the pre-flight capture, excerpt-distinct dedup in `buildSetupErrorComment`
- `js/common/legFailureReport.js` — phase guard in `renderReport`
- `scripts/report-leg-failure.sh` — `--slurpfile` payload (argv-free), stray-`}` fix, `--self-test` mode (17 assertions), unset-OUTCOME guard, `<run-url-unavailable>` fallback placeholder
- `js/unit-tests/test_preCliDevelopmentSetup.js` — workingDir-path suite, excerpt-dedup suite, helper-coverage suite (+ updated hard-cap test to an explicit excerpt)
- `js/unit-tests/test_legFailureReport.js` — phase-guard suite, self-test suite, node-harness scenario e2e suite; brittle greps removed, registration pins kept

Branch: `ai/gh-1363` — rework content in `6678c93e1..3c27347fc` (WIP auto-save commits), documented in `b828b3c03`.

## Test Coverage

- New/updated tests: workingDir pre-flight probes (2), excerpt dedup (3), helper branch coverage (7), phase guard (2), self-test e2e (1), scenario e2e (4); 3 brittle greps removed, 3 pins kept.
- **Node harness (CI quality-gate runtime)**: full `run_all.json` → **8715 passed, 1 failed** — the failure is `sessionDelta UT-3 AC3`, verified identical on clean base `f3183be` (see Issues/Notes).
- **dmtools GraalJS runner (canonical green gate)**: full `run_all.json` → **8701 passed, 0 failed**; targeted: `run_legFailureReport.json` 58/58, `run_preCliDevelopmentSetup.json` 82/82, `run_workingDir.json` 22/22.
- **`bash scripts/report-leg-failure.sh --self-test`** → PASS, exit 0.
- **Crap gate** (CI harness replicated, released baseline) → `0 regression(s), 0 new over threshold`, exit 0.
- Duplication gate surface: `scripts/` is outside the `crap4js duplicates js ci` scan scope; `js` changes are pure extractions with no duplicated-block growth.
